Math to sleep by. 

The preferred dividends cost $1.5b a year.  Or 2.8% of the present coin value. 
This $1.5b/ 847k coins equals $1700 of coin value. If bitcoin moves from $60K to $61.7k then the dividend is “paid”. 
The preferreds are owed only what the dividend rate is. Ever.
